verdicts.reason: A and B look pixel-identical, and both are unusable for the same reasons. The background photo is cropped into a blurry, upscaled close-up that drops the Tower Bridge imagery and the translucent panel behind the text. Dark text sits straight on a busy photo, so it is hard to read. 'FAMILY DAYS OUT IN' is cut off from its headline 'London' and pushed to the lower left, which breaks the reading order. The chevrons are blown up into a huge row of six that crowds the tagline and becomes the focal point. The layout has no common edge or grid.
